data.name: Janaah
data.gender_notes: Janaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A gentle breeze that carries the scent of paradise. Symbolizes refreshment, tranquility, and spiritual renewal. The name Janaah carries the meaning “Gentle breeze” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Janaah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle breeze and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's gentle blessings and the refreshing peace found in His presence.
data.etymology: Janaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle breeze.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Janaah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
